_说明: Kimi WebBridge 自定义信息源配置。每个源的 enabled 设为 true 后，finhot 会通过浏览器抓取该站点内容。提取代码使用标准 JavaScript，需返回 JSON.stringify([...]) 格式。
_用法: ① 将需要启用的源 enabled 改为 true  ② 确保 Kimi WebBridge 浏览器扩展已连接  ③ finhot 自动读取此配置

sources.name: 雪球
sources.description: 投资者社区，个股讨论、机构观点、市场情绪

extraction.code: (() => { const items = []; const articles = document.querySelectorAll('.timeline__item, article'); articles.forEach(el => { const title = el.querySelector('a')?.textContent.trim(); if (title && title.length > 8) items.push({ title: title, url: el.querySelector('a')?.href || '' }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 15)); })()

(() => { const items = []; document.querySelectorAll('.article-item-title, .item-title, [class*="title"] a').forEach(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); if (t && t.length > 8 && !items.find(i => i.title === t)) items.push({ title: t, url: el.href }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 20)); })()

(() => { const items = []; document.querySelectorAll('.article-item, .news-item, [class*="article"] [class*="title"]').forEach(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); if (t && t.length > 8) items.push({ title: t, url: el.closest('a')?.href || '' }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 20)); })()

sources.name: 中国银行保险报
sources.description: 保险行业垂直新闻、监管动态（最对口信源）

extraction.code: (() => { const items = []; document.querySelectorAll('a[class*="title"], .news-list a, .article-title').forEach(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); if (t && t.length > 8) items.push({ title: t, url: el.href }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 20)); })()

sources.name: 21世纪经济报道
sources.description: 金融政策、银行/保险专题深度报道

extraction.code: (() => { const items = []; document.querySelectorAll('.list-content a, .news-list a, [class*="title"]').forEach(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); if (t && t.length > 8 && !items.find(i => i.title === t)) items.push({ title: t, url: el.href || el.closest('a')?.href || '' }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 20)); })()

extraction.code: (() => { const items = []; document.querySelectorAll('.news-title, .article-title, [class*="list"] a[class*="title"]').forEach(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); if (t && t.length > 8) items.push({ title: t, url: el.href || '' }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 20)); })()

(() => { const items = []; document.querySelectorAll('.title, [class*="title"] a, .feed-card-title, h1, h2, h3').forEach(el => { const t = el.textContent.trim(); if (t && t.length > 8 && !t.includes('扫码') && !t.includes('下载') && !items.find(i => i.title === t)) items.push({ title: t, url: el.closest('a')?.href || '' }); }); return JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 25)); })()
